messages:
morgan: Heads-up — starting canary publish for py/ts SDKs in 15m (quiet window). Will use dist-tag 'canary-2026-03-21' and shadow-route ~5% traffic. Ping if any objections.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary publish: py@canary-2026-03-21, ts@canary-2026-03-21. Start in 15m. CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/1755001234

carla: smoke tests green on staging for the tag. I can watch logs & smoke runner.

dmitri: quick note — last time we saw ~+1.8% 500s on /v1/embeddings for a small cohort during canary. Recommend abort threshold = 2% error increase vs baseline.

eva: agree with threshold. Also we should pin fallback wheels for pip: fallback to 'redwood-sdk==0.12.3-prod' in case auto-fallback triggers.

morgan: ok setting holdback threshold to 1.5% to be conservative. Who owns release notes and deprecation blurb?

docs-kate: I'll draft release notes and include deprecation blurb for the legacy sync client (TS). ETA ~30m.

release-bot: canary started at 1755001239. Jobs: publish-py, publish-ts, smoke-runner. Dashboard: https://ci.redwood.internal/dash/1755001239

carla: smoke-runner flagged a flake in streaming tests — reconnect loop appears in logs, reconnects spiked x20 for the canary cohort.

dmitri: reconnects + the 1.8% 500s concern me. Proposal: abort canary and pinback if reconnect rate > 10/min or error delta > 1.5%.

morgan: :thumbsup: I vote abort given the reconnect spike. @deploy-bot can you run rollback/pinback sequence and unpublish canary tags?

deploy-bot: Executing rollback sequence now. Steps: unpublish canary dist-tags and repoint traffic to prod. Commands run: ```npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary-2026-03-21 || true
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk canary-2026-03-20
python -m pip index remove redwood-sdk==0.13.0-canary || true
# patched registry entries to point to 0.12.3-prod fallback
```

eva: After rollback I'll open a PR to pin packages in the release branch and update the internal registry TTLs. PR coming: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234

docs-kate: Updating release notes: "Canary aborted due to streaming reconnect regression; investigating root cause. Will re-run canary after fix. Legacy sync client deprecation note included."

morgan: Thanks. If the postmortem looks like it's warranted we'll move it to #postmortems. Tentative re-run once fix merged — target tomorrow 12:00 UTC.

carla: :ok_hand:

dmitri: :eyes: monitoring the metrics dashboard.

eva: PR posted ^ link above.

docs-kate: Done draft; will push final once we confirm rollback is complete.
